estimands.condition_mean_caveat: the replicated-condition population is not a random subset of the source: repeats concentrate on multi-plate, multi-article conditions
estimands.dose_design_note: dose and fold are confounded by design: each fold holds exactly one dose, so dose and fold effects cannot be disentangled
estimands.fold: equal-fold mean and fold sample SD (ddof=1); sample_equal_pooled is recorded for comparison and is never the headline
estimands.noise_floor: median over replicated conditions of sqrt(mean over genes of the within-condition Delta variance, ddof=0) (population SD; headline)
estimands.paired: equal-fold mean of paired (view - full) differences per seed, then equal-seed mean; half-width = 1.96*sqrt((fold_sd/sqrt(n_folds))**2 + (seed_sd/sqrt(n_seeds))**2), fold_sd = equal-seed mean of the per-seed fold sample SDs (ddof=1), seed_sd = sample SD of the per-seed equal-fold means (ddof=1); fold and seed spread are never pooled into one bar
estimands.paired_single_seed: equal-fold mean of paired (view - full) differences; half-width = 1.96*fold_sd/sqrt(n_folds) with fold_sd the fold sample SD (ddof=1); single-seed sensitivity, no seed spread, reported separately from the main arms
estimands.pcc_ceiling: profile-weighted mean of sqrt(rho_c) over the source's replicated conditions; heuristic diagnostic, not a measurement-error model
estimands.run: per-profile sample-equal Delta metrics of one run (equal weight per profile)
estimands.seed: headline = mean of per-seed equal-fold means; seed sample SD (ddof=1); fold and seed spread are reported separately, never pooled

mean_cell.definition: Step 04 axis-local Mean_cell: per cell line, the pooled mean of the fitted treated expression plus that cell line's unique original vehicles, scored Delta-space on the same frozen cold-drug-dose test rows
